name: Animate Armor, Greater
body:
School transmutation [metal]; Level sorcerer/wizard 4, vanguard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 10 minutes
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range touch
Targets one suit of full plate sized for a Large creature, or multiple suits of full plate sized for Medium creatures
Duration 10 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions like animate armor, except you can animate larger or multiple suits of armor. If you target a suit of full plate intended for a large creature, you can animate it to act as a giant phantom armor. As with animate armor, it loses the undead type, channel resistance, and undead traits and gains the construct type and construct traits. It gains an additional 30 hit points for being a large-sized construct.

If you choose to animate Medium-sized full plate, you can instead animate one suit of armor for every four caster levels you have (maximum 4).
